software / Automation

n8n

Connect events, data, and decisions into monitored workflows.

nOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

n8n orchestrates triggers, APIs, data transformations, and AI steps across business tools. We can structure an automation as a sequence with input checks, human review, and a visible failure path, rather than an opaque chain of actions. This is useful when marketing, sales, and operations need reliable handoffs and a clear record of what happened.

Useful outputs

  • Versioned workflow and connection map
  • Validation, retry, and error paths
  • Execution reporting and operating notes

Where we can apply it

  • Inbound pipeline: form event → data checks → CRM assignment → owner alert.
  • AI triage: request → structured classification → confidence review → approved action.
  • Reporting: schedule → source refresh → summary draft → stakeholder review.
01

Use case 1

Validate, enrich, and assign a new enquiry before it reaches a sales queue.

02

Use case 2

Synchronize approved records across a CRM, database, and reporting layer.

03

Use case 3

Prepare scheduled reports and alert an owner when an execution fails.

Inputs we need

  • Authorized credentials for selected systems
  • Event samples and required field mappings
  • Escalation rules and workflow owner

Delivery sequence

  • Define the trigger, expected data, and destination contract.
  • Build the workflow with guarded AI steps and error handling.
  • Test duplicates, unavailable services, and human escalation before activation.

Expert review points

  • Review data exposure in every third-party step.
  • Confirm retry logic cannot repeat sensitive actions.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • HubSpot
  • WhatsApp Business Platform
  • Supabase
  • HTTP APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Workflow success rate
  • Execution time
  • Exception rate
  • Time saved

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
